messages.author: 9f3646dab857d041
messages.subject: Re: export genetic map for qtl analyses
parts:
diaTEST is not a table - it's an rqtl cross object - so write.table won't work. 
Are you trying to export the map data (you can write out the map for each linkage group, e.g. diaTEST$geno[[1]]$map), or just save the cross for later (save(diaTEST, file = 'blah', ...)? 

I recommend reading, and doing, all of the excellent documentation and tutorials, by the way.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Re: export genetic map for qtl analyses
parts:
If you want to save the cross just to reuse it again in R, it's best to use save() and load():

save(diaTEST, file="diaTEST.RData")

load("diaTEST.RData")

If you write the cross to a CSV file, there's no way, currently, to have the genotypes written as A/H/B. But in your call to read.cross, you can use genotypes=c("AA", "AB", "BB"). You can leave off estimate.map=TRUE; that's only used if there is no map in the csv file, and there should be, following orderMarkers.

diaTESTmap <- read.cross("csv", ".", "diaTESTmap.csv", genotypes=c("AA", "AB", "BB"))

karl
